# Installing seabORD

This guide explains how to install **seabORD** directly from GitHub. Before getting started, ensure that you have **R** and **RStudio** installed and up to date.

## Prerequisites

To install packages from GitHub, you will need the **remotes** package:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("remotes")
```

## Installing seabORD

Install the latest development version from GitHub with:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
remotes::install_github("NERC-CEH/seabORD_pkg") 
```

## Load the package

Once installation is complete, load the package in your R session:

```{r, ,warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(seabORD)
```

## Updating seabORD

To update to the latest development version, rerun:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
remotes::install_github("NERC-CEH/seabORD_pkg")
```

## Next steps

Read[more about the seabORD model](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/seabORD_pkg/articles/B_explanation_model.html), [read about its inputs](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/seabORD_pkg/articles/C_KI_inputs.html), or [its main functions](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/seabORD_pkg/articles/J_main_functions.html), or start following the examples!
